name: sirius-ai
description: Multi-model AI for Sirius IDE — Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI, Ollama and eight more providers behind the editor's own chat, agent mode and inline chat. Thinking, native tool calling, image input for vision models, Tab completion, next-edit prediction.

commands.title: Sirius: Import from VS Code, Cursor, or Windsurf

enumDescriptions: OpenRouter — one key, hundreds of models

sirius.ai.defaultModel.description: Model used for AI chat. Prefer the "Sirius: Select AI Model" command, which lists everything the configured providers offer.

sirius.ai.gemini.apiKey.description: Google Gemini API key (get one from ai.google.dev)
sirius.ai.gemini.apiKey.markdownDeprecationMessage: Storing API keys in settings.json is insecure — the file is plaintext, is picked up by Settings Sync and is captured by dotfile backups. Sirius now keeps keys in the system keyring. Any key left here is moved automatically on startup and this setting is cleared. Use the **Sirius: Set API Key** command instead.
sirius.ai.gemini.apiKey.deprecationMessage: Deprecated: keys are now stored in the system keyring. Run "Sirius: Set API Key" instead.

sirius.ai.anthropic.apiKey.description: Anthropic API key (get one from console.anthropic.com)

sirius.ai.thinking.enabled.description: Enable thinking/reasoning mode for supported models (Claude Opus, Sonnet, Gemini 3.5)

enumDescriptions: Extra high — best for coding and agentic work
Max — maximum depth, when correctness beats cost
sirius.ai.thinking.effort.description: How deeply the AI should reason before responding

sirius.ai.temperature.description: AI response creativity (0 = deterministic, 2 = very creative)

sirius.ai.streamResponses.description: Stream AI responses token by token

sirius.ai.enable.markdownDescription: Tab completion, per language. `"*"` is the default for every language; a language id such as `"markdown"` or `"json"` overrides it. This is the switch the chat status dashboard toggles. Completions need a local FIM model — Ollama or llama.cpp; see `#sirius.ai.completions.model#`.

sirius.ai.inlineCompletions.deprecationMessage: Use sirius.ai.enable — it is per language and is what the chat status dashboard toggles. true here still turns completions on everywhere.

sirius.ai.openai.baseUrl.description: Override the OpenAI endpoint — e.g. an Azure deployment or a corporate proxy.

sirius.ai.custom.baseUrl.description: Base URL of any other OpenAI-compatible service, including the /v1 suffix.

sirius.ai.completions.model.description: Model for Tab completion: "auto" picks a running Ollama code model automatically; or "ollama/<model>"; or "llamacpp" for the configured llama.cpp server.

sirius.ai.completions.maxLines.description: Longest suggestion Tab completion will offer, in lines.

sirius.ai.ollama.largeModelBytes.description: Refuse to load Ollama models larger than this many bytes — protection against freezing the machine with a model that far exceeds its memory. 0 disables the check.

sirius.ai.nextEditSuggestions.enabled.description: Predict your next edit after each change and offer it as a Tab-able diff (experimental; needs a local FIM model). Requires Tab completion to be on — see sirius.ai.enable.
